fragen.text: Which of you feels the love in your relationship more strongly?
Which of you shows affection and closeness more openly in everyday life?
Which of you is more invested in their career?
Which of you gets more recognition for their work?
Which of you has the better touch with money?
Which of you plans spending and savings goals more actively?
Which of you has more energy and stamina in everyday life?
Which of you recovers more quickly from strain or illness?
Which of you has more friends of their own?
Which of you is more likely to take the initiative when you do something with others?
Which of you is the more creative mind in your relationship?
Which of you brings new ideas or unconventional solutions into everyday life more often?
Which of you brings change into your shared life more often – a move, a new job, trying something completely new?
Which of you deals more openly with upheaval and change?
Which of you cares more about spirituality, religion or the supernatural?
Which of you relies more on intuition or gut feeling in important decisions?
